steps.intro: Having bathed and worn a clean dhoti, sit or squat (kukkuṭāsana) facing east in the morning, north at midday, west in the evening. Sip water three times from the brāhma-tīrtha (base of the right thumb) for the purification of body, speech and mind.

items.meaning: Salutations to Acyuta, the unfallen one.
Salutations to Ananta, the infinite one.
Salutations to Govinda, protector of the world.

title.en: Touching the limbs with the twelve names

steps.intro: Touch the parts of the body indicated with the right hand, consecrating it as the temple of God.

items.action: index finger → right side of nose
index finger → left side of nose

steps.intro: With the fists gently tap the temples.

text.iast:
śuklāṃbaradharaṃ viṣṇuṃ śaśivarṇaṃ caturbhujam |
prasannavadanaṃ dhyāyet sarvavighnopaśāntaye ||

items.meaning: The all-pervading Lord Viṣṇu is to be meditated upon for the removal of obstacles — clad in white garments, resplendent like the moon, four-armed and cheerful-faced.

steps.intro: Fold the index and middle fingers into the right palm; close the nostrils with thumb and ring finger. Breathe out through the left nostril, breathe in; holding the breath recite the mantra; breathe out through the right. Breathe in through the right, hold and recite again, breathe out through the left. That is one round — do three.

text.iast:
oṃ bhūḥ | oṃ bhuvaḥ | oguṃ suvaḥ | oṃ mahaḥ | oṃ janaḥ | oṃ tapaḥ | oguṃ satyam |
oṃ tat sa̍vi̱tur vare̎ṇyaṃ bhargo̍ de̱vasya̍ dhīmahi | dhiyo̱ yo na̍ḥ praco̱dayā̎t ||
oṃ āpo̱ jyotī̱ raso̱'mṛta̱ṃ brahma̱ bhūr bhuva̱s suva̱rom ||

items.meaning: Om — the material world; Om — the realm of mind; Om — the realm of light; Om — the realm of vastness; Om — the realm of creative delight; Om — the realm of unobstructed will; Om — the realm of the highest Truth. May we meditate upon that adorable light of the divine Creator; may He impel our intellect. He is in the waters, in light, in flavour, in the nectar of immortality, and pervades the three realms — physical, mental and spiritual. All this is denoted by the Praṇava.

items.text: Then touch the right ear with the right hand (śrotrācamanam), and make brahmāñjali: left palm upturned on the right thigh, right hand downturned clasping it.

text.iast: hariḥ oṃ tatsat | govinda govinda govinda | mamopātta samasta duritakṣaya dvārā śrī parameśvara prītyarthaṃ {kala} sandhyām upāsiṣye ||

items.meaning: For the absolution of all my sins and to invoke the grace of the Supreme Lord, I now perform my {kalaEn} sandhyā worship.

text.iast: hariḥ oṃ tatsat | govinda govinda govinda | śrī bhagavadājñayā bhagavat kaiṅkarya rūpaṃ {kala} sandhyām upāsiṣye ||

items.meaning: By the command of the Lord and as service to Him alone, I now perform my {kalaEn} sandhyā worship.

steps.intro: If the ūrdhva-puṇḍram / tilakam was not applied after bath, apply it now with the middle finger dipped in water reciting *oṃ keśavāya namaḥ*. Then take water in the uddharaṇi with the left hand and, with the ring finger of the right hand, sprinkle water over the head with the following mantras.

text.iast: oṃ bhūr bhuva̱s suva̍ḥ | tat sa̍vi̱tur vare̎ṇyaṃ bhargo̍ de̱vasya̍ dhīmahi | dhiyo̱ yo na̍ḥ praco̱dayā̎t ||

āpo̱ hiṣṭhā ma̍yo̱ bhuva̱ḥ | tā na̍ ū̱rje da̍dhātana | ma̱he raṇā̍ya̱ cakṣa̍se |
yo va̍ś śi̱vata̍mo̱ rasa̱ḥ | tasya̍ bhājayate̱ha naḥ | u̱śa̱tīri̍va mā̱taraḥ |
tasmā̱ ara̍ṅga māma vaḥ |

items.action: sprinkle on the head with these seven mantras
items.meaning: O Waters! You are beneficent; grant us nourishment that we may behold great delight. Grant us a share in that great bliss you possess, like mothers in their tender love.
To you we come gladly for Him to whose abode you lead us.
Make us pure and grant us to be reborn with splendour.

items.action: take water in the hand and circle the head

steps.intro: Pour an uddharaṇi of water into the right palm, recite the mantra for the kāla, and sip it from the brahma-tīrtha.

text.iast: sūrya̍śca mā ma̱nyuśca̍ manyu̱pata̍yaśca̱ manyu̍kṛte̱bhyaḥ | pāpe̍bhyo rakṣa̱ntām | yad rātryā pāpa̍m akā̱rṣam | mana̍sā vā̱cā ha̱stābhyām | pa̱dbhyām u̱dare̍ṇa śi̱śnā | rātri̱s tad ava̍lu̱mpatu | yat kiñca̍ duri̱taṃ mayi̍ | i̱dam a̱haṃ mām amṛ̍ta yo̱nau | sūrye̍ jyoti̍ṣi juho̍mi svāhā̎ ||

items.meaning: May the Sun, anger, the lords of anger and the sins born of anger protect me. Whatever sin I have committed by night — by thought, speech, hands, feet, belly or organ — may the night efface it. Whatever evil remains in me, I offer myself as an oblation into the Sun, the source of immortality, the Light. Svāhā.

text.iast: āpa̍ḥ punantu pṛthi̱vīṃ pṛ̍thi̱vī pū̱tā pu̍nātu̱ mām | pu̱nantu̱ brahma̍ṇa̱spati̱r brahma̍ pū̱tā pu̍nātu̱ mām | yad ucchi̍ṣṭam abho̎jya̱ṃ yad vā̍ du̱ścari̍ta̱ṃ mama̍ | sarva̍ṃ punantu̱ mām āpo̍'sa̱tāṃ ca̍ prati̱graha̱guṃ svāhā̎ ||

items.meaning: May the waters purify the earth; may the purified earth purify me. May the Lord of prayer purify me; may the purified Veda purify me. Whatever remnant I have eaten, whatever forbidden food, whatever misdeed of mine, whatever gift accepted from the unworthy — may the waters purify me of all. Svāhā.

text.iast: a̱gniśca̍ mā ma̱nyuśca̍ manyu̱pata̍yaśca̱ manyu̍kṛte̱bhyaḥ | pāpe̍bhyo rakṣa̱ntām | yad ahnā pāpa̍m akā̱rṣam | mana̍sā vā̱cā ha̱stābhyām | pa̱dbhyām u̱dare̍ṇa śi̱śnā | aha̱s tad ava̍lu̱mpatu | yat kiñca̍ duri̱taṃ mayi̍ | i̱dam a̱haṃ mām amṛ̍ta yo̱nau | satye̍ jyoti̍ṣi juho̍mi svāhā̎ ||

items.meaning: May Agni, anger, the lords of anger and the sins born of anger protect me. Whatever sin I have committed by day — by thought, speech, hands, feet, belly or organ — may the day efface it. Whatever evil remains in me, I offer myself as an oblation into Truth, the source of immortality, the Light. Svāhā.

steps.intro: Repeat the sprinkling as before with *āpo hiṣṭhā*, preceded by this mantra.

text.iast:
da̱dhi̱krāvṇṇo̍ akāriṣaṃ ji̱ṣṇor aśva̍sya vā̱jina̍ḥ |
su̱ra̱bhi no̱ mukhā̍ kara̱t praṇa̱ āyū̍guṃṣi tāriṣat ||

items.meaning: I have glorified Dadhikrāvan, the victorious swift steed (the Lord as Hayagrīva). May He make our mouths fragrant and lengthen our lives. (RV 4.39.6; TS 1.5.11.4)

steps.intro: Prāṇāyāma, śrotrācamanam, brahmāñjali; then the saṅkalpa. Take an uddharaṇi of water in the right palm, recite the Gāyatrī, and pour it from the fingertips (deva-tīrtha). Three libations in the morning and evening, two at noon (some do one).

text.iast: hariḥ oṃ tatsat | govinda govinda govinda | mamopātta samasta duritakṣaya dvārā śrī parameśvara prītyarthaṃ {kala} sandhyā sūryārghya pradānaṃ kariṣye ||

items.meaning: For the absolution of all my sins and to invoke the grace of the Supreme Lord, I now offer libations of water to the Sun.

text.iast: hariḥ oṃ tatsat | govinda govinda govinda | śrī bhagavadājñayā bhagavat kaiṅkarya rūpaṃ {kala} sandhyā sūryārghya pradānaṃ kariṣye ||

items.meaning: By the command of the Lord and as service to Him, I now offer libations of water to the Sun.

text.iast: oṃ bhūr bhuva̱s suva̍ḥ | tat sa̍vi̱tur vare̎ṇyaṃ bhargo̍ de̱vasya̍ dhīmahi | dhiyo̱ yo na̍ḥ praco̱dayā̎t || oṃ sūryāya namaḥ | idam arghyam ||

items.action: pour the water from the fingertips with each recitation
items.meaning: We meditate on the adorable light of the divine Savitṛ; may He impel our thoughts. Salutations to the Sun — this libation.

steps.intro: If the sandhyā is performed after the prescribed time (e.g. after sunrise), an extra (fourth) libation is offered as atonement. Prāṇāyāma, śrotrācamanam, brahmāñjali; saṅkalpa; then offer the libation as before and sprinkle water around yourself with *oṃ bhūr bhuvas suvaḥ*.

text.iast: hariḥ oṃ tatsat | govinda govinda govinda | mamopātta samasta duritakṣaya dvārā śrī parameśvara prītyarthaṃ {kala} sandhyā kālātīta prāyaścittārthaṃ turīyārghya pradānaṃ kariṣye ||

items.meaning: …I now offer a fourth libation to the Sun to atone for performing my worship after the prescribed time.

text.iast: hariḥ oṃ tatsat | govinda govinda govinda | śrī bhagavadājñayā bhagavat kaiṅkarya rūpaṃ {kala} sandhyā kālātīta prāyaścittārthaṃ turīyārghya pradānaṃ kariṣye ||

items.meaning: …I now offer a fourth libation to the Sun to atone for performing my worship after the prescribed time.

text.iast: oṃ bhūr bhuva̱s suva̍ḥ | tat sa̍vi̱tur vare̎ṇyaṃ bhargo̍ de̱vasya̍ dhīmahi | dhiyo̱ yo na̍ḥ praco̱dayā̎t || oṃ sūryāya namaḥ | idam arghyam ||

items.meaning: Yonder Sun is Brahman; Brahman indeed am I.

title.en: Libations to the planets and the twelve names

steps.intro: Perform ācamanam and aṅga-nyāsam. Offer water from the deva-tīrtha (fingertips) for each name. Smārtas offer to the nine grahas and the twelve names; Śrī Vaiṣṇavas offer to the twelve names.

text.iast: ādityaṃ tarpayāmi | somaṃ tarpayāmi | aṅgārakaṃ tarpayāmi | budhaṃ tarpayāmi | bṛhaspatiṃ tarpayāmi | śukraṃ tarpayāmi | śanaiścaraṃ tarpayāmi | rāhuṃ tarpayāmi | ketuṃ tarpayāmi |

items.meaning: I satisfy (with water) the Sun, Moon, Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, Venus, Saturn, Rāhu and Ketu.

text.iast: keśavaṃ tarpayāmi | nārāyaṇaṃ tarpayāmi | mādhavaṃ tarpayāmi | govindaṃ tarpayāmi | viṣṇuṃ tarpayāmi | madhusūdanaṃ tarpayāmi | trivikramaṃ tarpayāmi | vāmanaṃ tarpayāmi | śrīdharaṃ tarpayāmi | hṛṣīkeśaṃ tarpayāmi | padmanābhaṃ tarpayāmi | dāmodaraṃ tarpayāmi ||

items.meaning: I satisfy Keśava … Dāmodara (the twelve names of Viṣṇu).
Om, That is Truth — may this be an offering to Brahman.

steps.intro: Cross the arms and touch the ears; state your lineage and name.

text.iast: abhivādaye {pravara} {arsheya} pravarānvita {gotra} gotraḥ {sutra} sūtraḥ yajuś śākhādhyāyī śrī {name} śarmā nāmāham asmi bhoḥ ||

items.meaning: I salute — I, of the pravara of the ṛṣis {pravara}, of the {gotra} gotra, of the {sutra} sūtra, a student of the Yajur śākhā, named {name} śarmā.
